name: Roommate ~Usagi-kei Hetare Danshi~
original_name: ルームメイト ～うさぎ系ヘタレ男子～
source:
Rosalia is my favorite sexy girl from a neighboring country.

It's been a few days since she joined our roommates by chance.

For me, life with a beautiful woman is full of temptations.

One day, I finally lost the temptation and made a "certain mistake..."

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20925]Freem![/url]]
translation:
Rosalia是我最喜欢的来自邻国的性感女孩。

她偶然加入我们的室友已经有几天了。

对我来说，和美丽女人在一起的生活充满了诱惑。

有一天，我终于失去了诱惑，犯了“某个错误……”

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20925]Freem![/url]]
